QuestInfo.name: [Mushroom Shrine Tales] Restoring the Balance
QuestInfo.0: Someone is being attacked by Oni at #m800021000#. The enemy of your enemy is surely a friend. Help them out!
QuestInfo.1: You decide to work alongside the Oni #p9112003# to restore the lifeforce of nature, and put the enraged Oni to rest.
QuestInfo.2: You gathered #t4009380# and restored the Sacred Idols. It feels as if the flow of Kamuna's lifeforce has been somewhat mended.
